visualCharacteristics: Full-width rotating hero carousel. Each slide is a full-bleed background photo with an overlaid white content card (heading, short description, one CTA button). Left/right arrow navigation and dot indicators below the slides.
contentPattern: Repeating slides; each slide = 2 cells: cell 1 image, cell 2 heading + description + CTA link. Multiple rows = multiple slides.
usage: Homepage hero / promotional banner with multiple rotating slides.
